name: 北極鷗
illustrationTaxon: Adult breeding plumage, sex unspecified; pale grey upperparts fading to whitish primaries, stout yellow bill, pink legs; first-years usually recorded in Hong Kong.

similarSpecies.distinction: 成鳥灰翅鷗初級飛羽灰色、比背稍深；北極鷗成鳥淡至灰白。
成鳥灰背鷗背部深石板灰、初級飛羽黑；北極鷗淡灰背及淡色初級飛羽。

featureNotes: 近景嘴及紅斑可見，為成鳥示意。
淡灰色翼上覆羽重疊紋理，畫面抽象。
折翼時淺色初級飛羽可見，羽尖部分靠圓邊；不是展翅飛行圖。
粉紅腿腳可見，部分腳趾被圓形遮罩切去。

sources.use: Substantive read: 64–77 cm, first/second year pale with pink bill black tip, adult pale grey back fading to whitish primaries, nonbreeding head streaks; 11 HK records, mostly first-year and mostly Deep Bay; circumpolar breeding, LC stable.
Glaucous-winged Gull adult pale grey upperparts and slightly darker primaries.
Slaty-backed adult dark slate-grey and black primaries.
LC, 55–77 cm, circumpolar breeding; HKBWS 64–77 cm, differing ranges attributed; renderer does not print length.
